title: The Spider Queen's Court
text: A hall of silk where courtiers with too many legs bow and part to let you through, their clicking voices hushed. Cocooned shapes hang from the rafters, some still moving. On a throne of webbing, a queen waits for you to show her the courtesy she is owed.

options.label: The Leader bows low, and shows her the courtesy she is owed.

outcomes.text: She is gracious, sending you away with a gift of her court's essence. A bitter taste lingers in your mouths for days.

options.label: Draw steel in her court. You will not bow to a spider.

outcomes.text: The courtiers stop bowing. All their legs unfold at once while the cocoons in the rafters go still to listen.

options.label: The richest House pays tribute in gold, for safe passage through her silk.

outcomes.text: She accepts the gold and grants safe passage. She will remember your House's name, which is not the same as a kindness.
